mainEntity.name: What is the key difference between Claude Code and Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Claude Code operates autonomously in the CLI with native MCP tools, while Cursor integrates tightly into a GUI editor with visual diffs.

mainEntity.name: Which coding tool is best for terminal users?

acceptedAnswer.text: Claude Code provides the deepest integration for terminal-first developers and full-stack architects.

mainEntity.name: How does Windsurf compare to Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsurf emphasizes multi-agent Cascades with autonomous terminal execution, while Cursor emphasizes real-time inline editing.

mainEntity.name: Can you use Cursor and Claude Code together?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many engineering teams use Cursor for interactive editing and Claude Code for complex multi-file architectural refactors.

mainEntity.name: How do these tools manage project context?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cursor uses vector codebase indexing, while Claude Code reads project hierarchies directly alongside CLAUDE.md guidelines.
